title: Remote Snooze not working
symptom: When the alarm goes off on my phone, I can snooze it fine. When the alarm goes off on my wife's phone, Remote Snooze does absolutely nothing. I have done it as a preventative, and it still happens, and I have done it to try and snooze her phone as its going off, and nothing happens either.
cause: The remote snooze settings were not correctly configured on the follower phones: 'accept remote snooze' was not set on the phones.
fix: Ensure that the phone sending the data has 'send snooze to all' checked, and the second phone has 'accept remote snooze' checked. Also ensure that 'wifi name must match' is not set if phones are not on the same WiFi network.
settings_changed: wifi name must match → not set
evidence_quote: The phone sending the data should have "send snooze to all" checked. The second phone should have "accept remote snooze".
